name: ocr-codex
description: Local image and PDF OCR to Markdown for Codex agents via the ocr CLI (DeepSeek-OCR-2). Stdio only, no MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Image and PDF to Markdown via local DeepSeek-OCR-2
interface.longDescription: Shell out to the ocr CLI to extract exact text from local images and PDFs, with fenced untrusted output and progressive pagination.
defaultPrompt: Use /ocr <path> to extract text from a local image or PDF.
